summary: Invoice - Printed invoice not reflecting all applied payments
reported_issue: An invoice with multiple payments applied shows the correct balance in Unpaid Invoices, but the finance and printed invoice PDF reflect an incorrect balance. Root cause per description: when ShopView is open in multiple tabs and payments are made/deleted simultaneously, state does not sync across tabs (label 'Duplicate_Tab').
expected_after_fix: The printed invoice should reflect the correct balance after all applied payments, matching the balance shown in the Unpaid Invoices tab.
steps_i_followed: No explicit single-tab repro exists (has_usable_repro=false); the reported defect is a cross-tab concurrency race (payments made/deleted simultaneously in duplicate tabs).
Performed the closest deterministic single-session check: opened a fully paid WO (S12-24602) Finance tab and compared the printed invoice totals to the finance balance.
actual_now: In a single session the printed invoice and finance are consistent: Total $164.85, Payments $164.85, Balance $0.00 (status Paid), and the printed invoice block shows the same $164.85 / $0.00. No discrepancy observed single-tab. The specific reported failure requires two browser tabs performing simultaneous payment create/delete to trigger a sync race - a timing-dependent concurrency condition that cannot be reliably reproduced in this automated single-session harness.
notes: Cross-tab / duplicate-tab concurrency race is not deterministically reproducible in the harness (no ability to drive two synchronized tabs racing create/delete). Single-tab printed-invoice-vs-finance balance is consistent, which is a positive signal but does not exercise the reported race. Recommend manual two-tab verification.
